dsgLayoutVerdicts.evidence: Fix 9da9218, in src/components/ImportMenu.jsx (unchanged since). At the head of claude/r4-green the menu is `absolute left-0 top-full mt-1 w-64` inside the `relative` wrapper that hugs the trigger (line ~42). Dashboard.jsx:169-171: the ImportMenu (shown only when `keeps`, i.e. a demo account) is the first child of the `flex flex-wrap` actions row, so it always starts a row. Below lg the header stacks (`flex-col lg:flex-row`, px-4 / sm:px-6), so the trigger sits at x=16 on phones, 24 from sm, and the 256 px menu spans 16..272. That is inside 320 and 375 px screens, and inside 640-1023 px, which covers the whole <768 px range the finding names plus the stacked tablet layout. At lg+ the row is right-justified and the ~800 px of actions put Import's left edge around x≈200 at 1024 px, so the menu (≈200..456) stays on screen. No overflow-hidden ancestor clips it. ImportMenu is used only by the Dashboard (ExportDropdown imports only ORIGINALS_HINT), so no other screen is affected. Both items and their handlers are unchanged. Test tests/pdf/103-r4-dph-25-import-menu-left-edge.test.mjs asserts `left-0` and no `right-0`, so it fails on the parent (`right-0`). No fail-first CI job for 9da9218 is recorded: runs 36371889367, 36371880365 and 36372088441 have no pair for it. I checked the revert by reading instead, and the named test is in the green gate history of r4-green (e.g. 36516263453 on 1f99a1a).

Fix 3dc10e8. At the head, src/components/ResumeCard.jsx:130 gives the rename input `flex-1 text-sm pointer-coarse:text-base ...`. Tailwind is ^4.3.1, where `pointer-coarse:` is a built-in @media (pointer: coarse) variant that comes after the base utilities, so the box is 16 px on touch and 14 px with a mouse. The later DVIS-28 commits (8a17031..71f5a7a) changed only the name measuring, which is off while Rename is open, and left the input's class alone. ResumeCard is the only dashboard card with a Rename (the only title/aria-label="Rename" in src). The Editor header's rename box is a separate row (DPH-29). The test tests/pdf/103-r4-dph-26-rename-box-touch-text.test.mjs requires the `pointer-coarse:text-base` token, so it fails on the parent. No fail-first CI job for 3dc10e8 is recorded in the dsg-layout runs, so I checked the revert by reading. Enter still renames, and the test checks that.

Fix 7242eea. I listed every input, select and textarea in the Design tab's files at the head: DesignPanel.jsx and its sections Colors, Typography, Dates, Headings, Lists, Links, PageNumbers, Shared and Template. SizeRow and NumberRow (DesignPanelShared.jsx:37,71), BorderPtBox (DesignPanelHeadings.jsx:41), the Date format select (DesignPanelDates.jsx:28), the OwnFontRow Name/Heading Font select (DesignPanelTypography.jsx:24), the Google Font box (:174) and the Design name box (DesignPanelTemplate.jsx:87) all carry pointer-coarse:text-base. The only other fields are ColorInput `type=color` swatches, which iOS does not zoom into. Lists, Links and PageNumbers have no text fields. Later commits to these files (24b78d1, 3347bca, ecc3304) kept the token. With a mouse the boxes keep text-xs/text-sm. At 16 px, values like '10.5' still fit the w-14 and w-10 boxes. Fail-first run 36371889367, job 'failfirst (7242eea:tests/pdf/103-r4-dph-33-design-fields-touch-text.test.mjs)': success. The test opens every section and Save my design and runs the under-16-on-touch sweep.

Fix 10dc2a5. StarterTemplateModal.jsx:~87-91: the name row is `flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 gap-y-1` and the badge is `whitespace-nowrap shrink-0`. The wrapper is `min-w-0 pr-3` and the arrow is shrink-0. Fail-first run 36371889367, job 'failfirst (10dc2a5:tests/pdf/103-r4-dph-39-starter-badge-wraps-whole.test.mjs)': success.

Fix e8afbaa, unchanged at the head of claude/r4-green (src/components/AtsCheckerPanel.jsx:298-318, 366, 375, 399-411). The tab root is now `@container` (Tailwind v4.3, so container queries are built in). Every sm: variant in the tab moved to @md: (448 px); no sm:, md: or lg: variant is left in AtsCheckerPanel, and AtsParserView has none either. The root's parent in Editor.jsx:156 is a block `px-4 py-4` div, so inline-size containment cannot collapse the root. In the default 360 px panel the tab is 328 px, below 448, so the score header stacks: the title gets the full card width and the badge (self-stretch) spans the card, so it cannot spill. The longest grade label, 'B · GOOD - MINOR TWEAKS NEEDED', is about 240 px and fits the stacked 286 px card. At the 448 px threshold the card's inner width is about 406 px, and badge + gap + the title's min-content come to about 363 px, so the side-by-side row fits. Phones (<448 px tab) stack as before. A 640-767 px phone in landscape and the full-width editor still go side by side. The plain-text card and the scanner header follow the same rule, and the '% Match' pill is now shrink-0. Fail-first on CI: run 36371889367, job 108769815215: 'fail without the fix (its diff reversed): # fail 1', then 'pass with it'. Residual, not a defect: in a panel dragged to about 480-520 px (tab 448-488) the title column beside the badge is still fairly narrow (about 110-150 px), but nothing overflows.

Fix 3a8770c. At the head, Dashboard.jsx:158-205: the header is `flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center`, the logo row is `w-full lg:w-auto shrink-0`, the compact AuthBar is `lg:hidden`, and the divider and full AuthBar are `hidden lg:block`. From 768 to 1023 px the header stacks. The row holds five visible actions (Import, Job Tracker, Projects, New Cover, New Resume; the hidden divider and sign-in add no gap), about 610-640 px against the 720 px available at 768, so they form one row. The compact sign-in sits beside the logo, and a signed-in user sees the SyncDot and avatar there. From lg the single row needs about 937 px: the finder's own wrap threshold was ~985 px, minus the 48 px of padding. At 1024 px there are 976 px available (about 961 with a classic 17 px scrollbar), so it fits with a margin of roughly 20-40 px. The row's '~810 of ~850' figures are off, but its conclusion holds. Phones (<640 px) and 640-767 px were already stacked and are unchanged. Cypress runs at 1440x900, so it still sees the full header. No spec selects md:hidden or md:flex-row on the Dashboard; the only e2e edit is the comment in 11-demo-account.cy.js. Fail-first on CI: run 36371889367, job 108769815286, succeeded (the test failed without the fix and passed with it).

Fix b02da95. At the head, the sidebar (Dashboard.jsx:313) is `lg:sticky lg:top-6 lg:flex lg:flex-col lg:max-h-[calc(100dvh-3rem)]`. It sits in an `items-start` flex row, so it is not stretched and sticky still works. Its heading row is shrink-0. CareerHistoryPanel.jsx:44-104 is `overflow-hidden flex flex-col min-h-0`: its header and footer are shrink-0, and the timeline is `min-h-0 overflow-y-auto` with the default flex-shrink. On a window about 650 px tall with 7+ entries, the timeline scrolls inside the panel while 'Open Job Tracker →' stays pinned in view. The timeline dots (-left-6 inside pl-6, ring-2) stay within the scroller's px-4 padding, so nothing is clipped. Below lg the sidebar is block with no max-h, so the panel is content height and nothing scrolls. In JobTracker.jsx:164-169 the aside is an unconstrained flex column in a content-start grid, so the panel keeps its content height there too. The Dashboard look is unchanged apart from the flex-column classes. Fail-first on CI: run 36371889367, job 108769815257, succeeded.

Fix b514074. At the head, CareerHistoryPanel.jsx:20-29 has LOOKS.workspace = `rounded-md border border-line`, no shadow, a `border-line` rule, a `rounded-md` avatar, and `text-ink` / `text-ink-subtlest`. These tokens exist in src/index.css:119-122 and match JobSummary.jsx:11/23 (`rounded-md border border-line bg-white`). JobTracker.jsx:168 passes variant="workspace", its only caller besides the Dashboard. The Dashboard default reproduces the old classes byte for byte (diff checked: rounded-2xl, border-gray-100, shadow-sm, text-gray-900/400, rounded-xl avatar), so the Dashboard does not regress. The class strings are written out in full, so Tailwind emits them. Fail-first on CI: run 36371889367, job 108769815304, succeeded. Minor leftover, not part of the row: the timeline's decorative gradient still ends in gray-100, and the colored role/NOW accents stay, both by design.

Fix 82905e3. At the head (AtsCheckerPanel.jsx:485-500) the category header button is `flex items-center justify-between gap-3`. The left column is `flex items-center gap-2.5 min-w-0`, the dot is `shrink-0`, and the title span is `text-sm font-bold leading-snug` with no truncate or nowrap, so as a flex item it can shrink to its longest word and wrap. The points badge and chevron are shrink-0. In the 360 px panel the title gets about 165 px, so 'Work Experience & Action Verbs', 'Contact & Header Information', 'ATS Standard Section Headings' and 'ATS Layout & Parser Safety' wrap to two lines. On a 320 px phone the title gets about 125 px: some titles take three lines, but none is cut, and the longest word ('Credentials', about 80 px) fits. cypress/e2e/27-ats-checker.cy.js matches the titles by text, which wrapping does not affect. Fail-first on CI: run 36371889367, job 108769815219, succeeded.

Fix 3347bca. At the head, DesignPanelTypography.jsx:183: the font box is `flex-1 min-w-0`, so it narrows and 'Add' / 'Checking…' stays inside the section at a 240-280 px panel (usePanelResize MIN = 240). DesignPanel.jsx:375-392: the Reset row is `flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3` and the text column is `flex-1 min-w-24`. In confirm state the buttons (Yes, Reset + Cancel) are about 156 px. A 240 px panel leaves the box about 182 px inside; 96 + 12 + 156 = 264 > 182, so the buttons wrap under the text and fit on their own line. A 360 px panel leaves about 302 px, 264 fits, so the buttons stay beside the text as before: the flex-basis 0 plus min-w-24 check holds, and the wrap starts below a panel of about 322 px, matching the row. The non-confirm 'Reset' button is unaffected. Fail-first on CI: run 36371889367, job 108769815258, succeeded.
